title: [review] duty_cycle.rs: debug_assert allows invalid duty_permille in relea
description: with_duty_permille(0) passes in release builds since debug_assert! is stripped. This causes max_tx_ms() to return 0, making remaining_ms() always 0 and can_transmit() always false for any duration > 0. A node initialized with duty_permille=0 would refuse all transmissions silently. Use assert! or return Result for invariant enforcement.
